The Vision Pro can play PCVR and Meta Quest games NATIVELY—but does it matter?

Half-Life: Alyx runs natively on Apple Vision Pro with no PC, no streaming and no Steam Link. It works through Glovebox, a new tool built on Max Thomas’s open-source Klepton project. Glovebox converts Valve’s ARM64 Steam Frame port from Linux ELF into Mach-O frameworks, signs it in Xcode and sideloads it with a paid Apple Developer account. Under the hood it’s a stack of clever hacks: x18 register rewrites, JIT-less LuaJIT and V8, the Increased Memory Limit and Extended Virtual Addressing entitlements, and glibc and OpenVR/SteamVR shims mapped to ARKit, GameController and Compositor Services.
title: Apple Should Be Embarrassed
